dialogues.title: First Day at School
dialogues.description: A new student meets her teacher on the first day.

lines.text: Good morning! You must be Maria, our new student.
lines.translation: Good morning! You must be Maria, our new student.

lines.text: Yes, that's right. Nice to meet you.
lines.translation: Yes, that's right. Nice to meet you.

lines.text: Welcome! Your seat is next to the window.
lines.translation: Welcome! Your seat is next to the window.

lines.text: Thank you. Where should I put my bag?
lines.translation: Thank you. Where should I put my bag?

lines.text: You can hang it on the hook by the door.
lines.translation: You can hang it on the hook by the door.

lines.text: Great, thank you very much!
lines.translation: Great, thank you very much!

dialogues.title: Doctor's Appointment
dialogues.description: A patient describes his symptoms to the doctor.

lines.text: Good morning, Tom. What brings you in today?
lines.translation: Good morning, Tom. What brings you in today?

lines.text: I've had a sore throat and a slight fever since yesterday.
lines.translation: I've had a sore throat and a slight fever since yesterday.

lines.text: I see. Have you been drinking enough water?
lines.translation: I see. Have you been drinking enough water?

lines.text: Not really, I've been quite busy with work.
lines.translation: Not really, I've been quite busy with work.

lines.text: Try to rest and stay hydrated. I'll prescribe something for the throat.
lines.translation: Try to rest and stay hydrated. I'll prescribe something for the throat.

lines.text: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.
lines.translation: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.

dialogues.title: Job Interview
dialogues.description: A candidate answers behavioral interview questions.

lines.text: So, Sarah, what would you say is your greatest strength?
lines.translation: So, Sarah, what would you say is your greatest strength?

lines.text: I'd say my ability to stay calm under pressure and prioritize effectively.
lines.translation: I'd say my ability to stay calm under pressure and prioritize effectively.

lines.text: Could you give an example of a time that was tested?
lines.translation: Could you give an example of a time that was tested?

lines.text: During a product launch, two systems failed simultaneously, and I coordinated the team to resolve both within the hour.
lines.translation: During a product launch, two systems failed simultaneously, and I coordinated the team to resolve both within the hour.

lines.text: Impressive. How do you handle disagreements with colleagues?
lines.translation: Impressive. How do you handle disagreements with colleagues?

lines.text: I try to understand their perspective first, then find common ground before proposing a solution.
lines.translation: I try to understand their perspective first, then find common ground before proposing a solution.

dialogues.title: The Job Interview
dialogues.description: A candidate discusses her career, challenges, and goals in a formal job interview.

lines.text: Thanks for coming in today. Could you walk me through your background?
lines.translation: Thanks for coming in today. Could you walk me through your background?

lines.text: Of course. I studied environmental engineering and spent the last three years working on renewable energy projects.
lines.translation: Of course. I studied environmental engineering and spent the last three years working on renewable energy projects.

lines.text: What would you say was the most challenging project you've handled?
lines.translation: What would you say was the most challenging project you've handled?

lines.text: Probably a solar installation that fell behind schedule due to permitting issues — I had to renegotiate timelines with three different stakeholders at once.
lines.translation: Probably a solar installation that fell behind schedule due to permitting issues — I had to renegotiate timelines with three different stakeholders at once.

lines.text: How did you keep the team aligned under that kind of pressure?
lines.translation: How did you keep the team aligned under that kind of pressure?

lines.text: I set up short daily check-ins so problems surfaced early instead of piling up until the deadline.
lines.translation: I set up short daily check-ins so problems surfaced early instead of piling up until the deadline.

lines.text: That's a solid approach. Where do you see yourself professionally in five years?
lines.translation: That's a solid approach. Where do you see yourself professionally in five years?

lines.text: Ideally leading a small team, still hands-on with the technical side rather than purely managerial.
lines.translation: Ideally leading a small team, still hands-on with the technical side rather than purely managerial.

lines.text: Do you have any questions for us before we wrap up?
lines.translation: Do you have any questions for us before we wrap up?

lines.text: Yes — how does the team typically handle disagreements about project priorities?
lines.translation: Yes — how does the team typically handle disagreements about project priorities?

dialogues.title: A Debate About Technology and Society
dialogues.description: Two friends debate the effects of social media, using persuasive language and discourse markers.

lines.text: Honestly, I think social media has done more harm than good for how teenagers communicate.
lines.translation: Honestly, I think social media has done more harm than good for how teenagers communicate.

lines.text: I get where you're coming from, but isn't it a bit unfair to blame the platforms for something that's really about how people use them?
lines.translation: I get where you're coming from, but isn't it a bit unfair to blame the platforms for something that's really about how people use them?

lines.text: Maybe, but the algorithms are deliberately designed to keep people scrolling, regardless of whether it's good for them.
lines.translation: Maybe, but the algorithms are deliberately designed to keep people scrolling, regardless of whether it's good for them.

lines.text: That's fair. Still, I'd argue the same tools have made it easier for people to stay in touch across huge distances.
lines.translation: That's fair. Still, I'd argue the same tools have made it easier for people to stay in touch across huge distances.

lines.text: Sure, but staying 'in touch' through likes and comments isn't the same as an actual conversation.
lines.translation: Sure, but staying 'in touch' through likes and comments isn't the same as an actual conversation.

lines.text: True. Maybe the real issue isn't the technology itself, but how little we teach people to use it thoughtfully.
lines.translation: True. Maybe the real issue isn't the technology itself, but how little we teach people to use it thoughtfully.

lines.text: That I can agree with. If schools spent even a little time on that, it might change things.
lines.translation: That I can agree with. If schools spent even a little time on that, it might change things.

lines.text: Exactly — it's less about banning the tools and more about building better habits around them.
lines.translation: Exactly — it's less about banning the tools and more about building better habits around them.
